title: EVERY WORD OF GOD IS PURE
PROVERBS 30:5 PRAYER
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: In this quiet room where worry about tomorrow is pressing in, hear this promise.
Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
Lord, we anchor our heart in the absolute truth of Your holy word today.
When fear threatens your peace or accusations arise, remember that God's spoken promise cannot fail.
He surrounds you with divine protection, guarding your thoughts and securing every step you take.
Put your full trust in Him, for He is your invincible fortress against every fiery dart.
Subscribe to The Covenant Shield to walk daily under His divine protection.
